title: PSMT Data Transfer
description: Transfer export of all soft-sided and hard-sided products for another Cursor project (Portable Solution Mapping Tool or similar). Dimensions are raw source values — not comparison-tool display ceiling-rounding.

rules.dimensionPriority: Vendor sheet first, then data.js, then PSC only when no cleaner source exists.
rules.excluded: Non-dimension comparison specs (wind, snow, fire, setup, ground, lifespan, repair) omitted by request.
rules.ceilingRounding: Comparison-tool display often ceiling-rounds external L×W to whole feet. This file prefers raw pre-round values when known.
